mapper.insert: INSERT INTO executor (tenant_id, agent_id, name, token_ref, status, client_kind, launch_config, creator_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentId}, #{name}, #{tokenRef}, #{status}, #{clientKind}, #{launchConfig}, #{creatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM executor WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT e.*, a.name AS agent_name FROM executor e LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = e.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.is_deleted = 0
AND e.agent_id IN ( SELECT sm.agent_id FROM squad_member sm
JOIN squad s ON s.id = sm.squad_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sm.squad_id IN #{sqid} )
ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.*, a.name AS agent_name FROM executor e LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = e.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.agent_id IN
#{aid}
(NULL)
ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.*, a.name AS agent_name FROM executor e LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.id = e.agent_id AND a.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.agent_id = #{agentId} AND e.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE executor SET is_deleted = 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE executor SET token_ref = #{tokenRef} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE executor SET last_connect_ip = #{lastConnectIp}, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE executor SET last_heartbeat = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, agent_id, name, client_kind FROM executor WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM executor WHERE client_kind = #{clientKind} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY last_heartbeat DESC, id ASC
